title: MSE Wall Exclusion - Both End Bents
case_name: C015 - MSE Wall Exclusion - Both End Bents (journal values, feb1bb316d08)
intro: **What it does.** The MSE wall exclusion boxes at both end bents: the minimum front pile-face clear for a skewed strap of the trial width, the specified 24-in side clear, and the gap from every pile face to the front and side wall lines of the CAD model, with the separate 24-in cap-face setback of SDG 3.13.2.N.2.
overview: Clearance between the end-bent piles and the MSE wall facing so that the soil-reinforcement straps clear the piles. The front wall needs the calculated minimum clear for a strap of the trial width at the selected skew; the side walls need the specified 24-in pile-face clear. Both are compared with the wall lines of the CAD model at each pile of both end bents, using the nominal pile width without a placement envelope.

In the CAD model the side walls stand at the 24-in criterion within 0.0002 in, so the side-wall rows read MEETS CLEAR or SHORTFALL only by the last digits of the model coordinates. The 24-in setback from the front cap face to the back of the front facing is a separate check.
outside: the strap design itself (Specialty Engineer), the cheek webs outside the cap ends, and the wall facing design.
working_notes: The calculation was ported from the journal module MSEWallExclusion (journal feb1bb316d08); every definition of the module was evaluated independently from the journal file and reproduced by the notebook to 1 part in 10⁹ before this edition was written.
